big_picture_notes: Ephesians is architected in two movements marked by the ‘walk’ motif: chs. 1–3 set the indicative (who we are in Christ) and chs. 4–6 set the imperative (how we walk in Christ). Literary glue includes the pervasive ‘in Christ/in him’ anaphora, the unity theme (Jew/Gentile; one body/one Spirit/one hope…), and macro‑syntax such as the single doxological sentence (1:3–14). The structure insists that ethics flow from theology: heavenly blessing → corporate reconciliation → unified conduct and spiritual warfare.

stories.story_title: The Eternal Plan: Union, Riches, and Resurrection Power
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (1:1) epistolary salutation opens the letter; end (2:22) completes the new‑temple metaphor (‘dwelling place of God in the Spirit’), capping the corporate identity argument. Glue: ‘in Christ’ leitwort and ‘riches’ vocabulary tie election, redemption, inheritance, and life together.

scenes.scene_name: Salutation and Grace
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Starts with apostolic identification; ends with grace/peace benediction. Devices: epistolary salutatio/benedictio, theme preview (grace/peace).

scenes.scene_name: Chosen and Adopted Before the Foundation of the World
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Every spiritual blessing: chosen in Him to be holy, predestined for adoption to the praise of His grace.

scenes.scene_name: Redemption and the Mystery of His Will
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Redemption through His blood and the plan to unite all things in heaven and earth in Christ.

scenes.scene_name: Sealed with the Promised Holy Spirit
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Chosen as God's own and sealed with the Spirit, the pledge of our inheritance.

scenes.scene_name: Prayer for a Spirit of Wisdom and Revelation
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Paul prays they would know the hope of His calling and the greatness of His power toward believers.

scenes.scene_name: Christ Seated Far Above All, Head Over the Church
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The risen Christ exalted above every rule, made head over all things for His body, the church.

scenes.scene_name: Dead in Trespasses, Children of Wrath
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Once walking in the ways of the world and the ruler of the air, by nature children of wrath.

scenes.scene_name: But God, Rich in Mercy, Made Us Alive
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Out of great love, raised and seated with Christ to display the riches of His grace.

scenes.scene_name: The Essence of Salvation
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘For by grace… through faith’ explains 2:1–7; ends with created for good works to walk in. Devices: justification mini‑summary, works‑purpose closure.

scenes.scene_name: Once Far Off, Now Brought Near by the Blood
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Gentiles formerly without hope and without God, now brought near through the blood of Christ.

scenes.scene_name: He Is Our Peace, Breaking Down the Dividing Wall
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Christ abolishing the hostility to make one new man, granting both access to the Father by one Spirit.

scenes.scene_name: The Church as God’s New Temple
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘So then…’ logical conclusion; ends with dwelling place of God. Devices: architectural metaphor (foundation/cornerstone/temple), corporate identity resolution.

stories.story_title: The Revelation of the Mystery and the Body’s Unity
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (3:1) parenthetical commission digression; end (4:16) body growth in love completes unity/gifts argument before broader ethics. Glue: ‘mystery’ terminology (3:3–9) and the sevenfold ‘one’ (4:4–6) bridging doctrine to unity appeal.

scenes.scene_name: The Stewardship of Grace and the Mystery
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Paul the prisoner for the Gentiles, given insight into the mystery of Christ by revelation.

scenes.scene_name: Gentiles Fellow Heirs Through the Gospel
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The mystery now revealed: Gentiles are fellow heirs and partakers of the promise in Christ.

scenes.scene_name: Cosmic Purpose of the Ministry
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Least of saints given grace to unveil wisdom to rulers; ends with bold access and exhortation not to lose heart. Devices: self‑abasement vs cosmic scope, teleology of suffering.

scenes.scene_name: Prayer to Know the Love of Christ
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Bowing his knees, Paul prays for inner strength to grasp the surpassing love of Christ and God's fullness.

scenes.scene_name: Doxology: To Him Who Is Able
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Glory to the One able to do immeasurably more than we ask, in the church and in Christ forever.

scenes.scene_name: Walk Worthy in Unity
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: ‘I… urge you to walk’ hinge from indicative→imperative; ends with ‘one…’ heptad. Devices: ‘walk’ structural marker, anaphoric ‘one’ list.

scenes.scene_name: Diversity of Gifts from the Ascended Christ
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Grace to each; Ps 68 descent/ascent; ends ‘that he might fill all things’. Devices: proof‑text interlude, triumph imagery.

scenes.scene_name: Gifts for Maturity and Love
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Given ministers to equip until maturity; ends with body building itself in love. Devices: body‑under‑Head metaphor, infancy→maturity contrast.

stories.story_title: The New Walk in the World and Spiritual Warfare
stories.why_start_end_and_literary_glue: Start (4:17) ‘no longer walk’ launches imperative section; end (6:24) benediction closes epistle. Glue: repeated ‘walk’ (4:17; 5:2, 8, 15), old/new self clothing metaphor, Haustafel sequence, and armor of God imagery.

scenes.scene_name: No Longer Walk as the Gentiles
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The futile, darkened, callous walk of the alienated who give themselves over to sensuality.

scenes.scene_name: Put Off the Old Self, Put On the New
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Taught in Christ to discard the corrupt old self and put on the new self, created like God.

scenes.scene_name: Speak Truth, Be Angry Without Sin, Work and Give
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Put off falsehood, do not let anger fester or give the devil a foothold, and work to share with the needy.

scenes.scene_name: Wholesome Speech; Be Kind and Forgiving
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: No unwholesome talk; do not grieve the Spirit; be kind and forgiving as God forgave you.

scenes.scene_name: Walk in Love; No Immorality or Crude Talk
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Imitate God and walk in love; let there be no hint of immorality, greed, or crude joking, but thanksgiving.

scenes.scene_name: No Immoral Person Has Inheritance
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The immoral and idolatrous have no inheritance in the kingdom; do not be deceived or partake with them.

scenes.scene_name: Walk as Children of Light
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Once darkness, now light: walk as children of light, testing what pleases the Lord.

scenes.scene_name: Expose Works of Darkness; Awake, O Sleeper
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Have no fellowship with darkness but expose it — 'Wake up, O sleeper, and Christ will shine on you.'

scenes.scene_name: Walk Wisely, Understanding the Lord's Will
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pay careful attention to your walk, redeeming the time and understanding the will of the Lord.

scenes.scene_name: Be Filled with the Spirit; Sing and Submit
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Be filled with the Spirit, singing and giving thanks, submitting to one another in reverence for Christ.

scenes.scene_name: Wives, Submit to Your Husbands
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: As the church submits to Christ the head, so wives to their husbands.

scenes.scene_name: Husbands, Love as Christ Loved the Church
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Christ gave Himself to sanctify and present her radiant, without spot or blemish.

scenes.scene_name: Love Your Wife as Your Own Body
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: As a man cares for his own body, so he is to nourish and cherish his wife, members of Christ's body.

scenes.scene_name: The Two Become One: A Profound Mystery
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: The one-flesh union as a picture of Christ and the church — each loving his wife, the wife respecting him.

scenes.scene_name: Children and Fathers
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Children obey and honor parents; fathers raise them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

scenes.scene_name: Slaves and Masters
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Slaves serve as to Christ from the heart; masters cease threats, knowing the same Master shows no favoritism.

scenes.scene_name: Put On the Whole Armor of God
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Be strong in the Lord against the spiritual forces of evil; take up the full armor to stand.

scenes.scene_name: Belt, Breastplate, Shoes, Shield, Helmet, Sword
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Stand armed with truth, righteousness, the gospel of peace, faith, salvation, and the word of God.

scenes.scene_name: Pray at All Times; Pray for Me
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Pray in the Spirit always and for Paul, an ambassador in chains, to proclaim the gospel boldly.

scenes.scene_name: Tychicus Sent; Final Peace and Grace
scenes.why_start_end_and_devices: Tychicus to report Paul's affairs; closing peace, love, and grace to all who love the Lord.
